description: Retrieve the citation network for an opinion cluster. Supports two directions: "cited_by" (opinions that cite this one — measures precedential influence) and "citing" (opinions this one cites — reveals the authority chain relied on). This is the primary tool for tracing legal precedent chains. Note: the free tier supports shallow traversal — following 1–2 hops of a single case is practical; deep multi-hop analysis burns through the daily budget quickly.

cluster_id.description: Opinion cluster ID to retrieve citations for. Obtain from courtlistener_search_opinions or courtlistener_lookup_citation.

court.description: Filter results to a specific court (e.g., "scotus", "ca9"). Applies to both directions.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from next_cursor. For citing, a nonnegative safe decimal integer offset; for cited_by, an opaque upstream token.

direction.description: "cited_by" (default): opinions that cite this one — measures precedential influence and downstream adoption. "citing": opinions this one cites — reveals the authority chain the court relied on.

filed_after.description: Limit to citations filed after this date (ISO 8601). For "cited_by", useful for "how has this precedent been applied recently?"

page_size.description: Positive requested size (default 20), bounded to 20. cited_by has an upstream minimum of 20; citing slices at most 20 cited IDs by the bounded size before filtering. Full upstream pages are preserved. Final or filtered pages can be smaller or empty; retain next_cursor to continue. page_sizing distinguishes requested, bounded and actual sizes. A normal call costs three requests plus extra variant pages.

name: courtlistener_get_citations

direction.description: Direction of the citation relationship returned.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_cursor`: A citing cursor is not a nonnegative safe decimal integer offset. `not_found`: Cluster ID does not exist in CourtListener. Both directions resolve the source cluster before searching, so a bad ID fails here rather than returning an empty network. `rate_limited`: 429 from CourtListener, or no request slot opened within the wait budget. `invalid_date`: filed_after is not a valid ISO 8601 calendar date. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page; null when no more results.

notice.description: Context when no citations are returned — either that this page had no match under the filters and more pages remain, or a recovery hint echoing direction and filters.

observed_total.description: Citation total observed from the fetched source variants; a lower bound when total_is_partial is true.

page_sizing.description: Requested, bounded, and actual page sizes.

actual.description: Rows returned to the caller after any page-local filters.

bounded.description: Size sent upstream or used for the cited-ID slice.

upstream.description: Upstream minimum, fixed page, or cited-ID slicing policy; final pages may contain fewer rows.

results.description: Related opinions in the citation network.

items.description: Related opinion in the citation network.

case_name.description: Case name of the related opinion.

citations.description: Citation strings for the related opinion.

cite_count.description: This opinion's own citation count — its authority weight.

cluster_id.description: Cluster ID of the related opinion.

court.description: Court that issued the related opinion.

court_id.description: Court identifier for use in filter parameters.

date_filed.description: Date the related opinion was filed.

snippet.description: Matched text excerpt from the related opinion, taken from the first opinion variant in the cluster that carries one; empty string when none does. It is a relevance preview for the cluster, not necessarily text surrounding the citation itself.

source_case_name.description: Case name for the source cluster.

source_cluster_id.description: The cluster ID this citation network is for.

source_variants_completion.description: Completion of the source opinion-variant walk.

complete.description: True only when all source variants were fetched.

next_cursor.description: Remaining upstream variant cursor; null at the end.

totalCount.description: Exact total for the fetched direction when source variants are complete; absent when total_is_partial is true. For cited_by this counts matching clusters after filters; for citing it counts distinct cited opinions before any filter, which can exceed the cluster rows.

total_is_partial.description: True when citation results and totals are based on an incomplete source-variant set.

title: Get Citation Network
